content: A control that cannot perturb its check certifies nothing. When a check reads GitHub or a child repository, no edit to the local tree can break it, so the control must inject the answer instead. DOC_OVERRIDE and LICENCE_OVERRIDE are those seams.
A diffable seed means a reviewer can read what changed in memory, which a binary blob never allowed.
A repo-managed project uses a .git symlink into .repo/projects. A directory created by hand before it entered the manifest has a real .git directory and fails sync with unsupported checkout state.
Derived data is not committed; memory/*.parquet is the source and the sqlite index is built from it.

Do not average jagged profiles into a modal answer. Fifteen people naming fifteen different primaries do not want the mean of those; they want the adjustment mechanism that lets each have theirs. Build the seat rail, not a seat position.
JSON Lines beats parquet for a small relation: one tuple per line diffs in git, and four parquet footers cost more than the data.
Never clone a project into a scratch directory; add it to the manifest and let repo sync bring it in. Work left uncommitted in a scratchpad is lost with the session.

Rung 0 of the planner ladder does not run. The client at cassie or entities-gyre constructs LLMModel and LLMChat from modules/llm, and no engine in the manifest carries that module; it exists only in V-Sekai-fire/turboquant-godot.

Store phase vectors on the uint16 grid encode_atom already uses, not float64: a quarter the size, exact for atoms, and byte-equal regardless of component order because rounding to the grid absorbs the float non-associativity.
The first step must be useful on its own if the work stops there. Plumbing that delivers nothing to anyone is not a first step. A failure that measures the gap is a valid result.

Third-party licences follow Google's policy at opensource.google/documentation/reference/thirdparty/licenses. Notice ships anywhere, reciprocal obliges source availability, restricted taints, and any unlisted licence is forbidden without approval.

Verify that an artefact does its job, not that it exists. A file with the right name and size can be a copy of its own input; a check can report ok while its breakage pattern has gone stale; documentation can describe a licence the files do not carry. Open the thing and compare it.
cassie-patch-verify data/patches_mesh.json is a byte-identical copy of data/hat_mesh.json, so the Lean oracle has never produced output and the oracle-to-C++ mesh diff cannot be built until it does.

encode_fact is order-sensitive at the bit level though not mathematically: bundle sums sin and cos, float addition is not associative, so entities must be sorted for a rebuild to be byte-identical. The vectors agree to 1e-14 radians either way.
